name: infer-conventions
title_zh: 翻遍代码库，把你们实际在用的写法写成 .ai/rul
tagline_zh: 团队里 Form Request 和 inline validation 混着用。
tagline_en: Your team mixes Form Requests and inline validation, and nobody can say which is the standard. It scans the code.
desc_en: Use this skill to analyze how a Laravel application is actually written and record its conventions as shared rules. Trigger when the user wants to detect, infer, document, or standardize project conventions or coding style, set up or grow `.ai/rules`, resolve mixed or conflicting patterns (e.g. \"are we using Form Requests or inline validation?\"), or onboard agents and teammates to \"how we do th
why_zh: 不预设任何风格偏好，只统计代码里实际怎么写的。冲突不替你选，摆出来等你裁决——规则是人定的。
why_en: No style opinions baked in; it only counts what the code actually does. Conflicts are surfaced, not auto-resolved — you decide.
limit_zh: 只认 Laravel 项目，且要有一定代码量才推得出规律，空壳或刚起步的仓库会直接告诉你样本不够。
limit_en: Laravel only, and it needs enough existing code to infer patterns — near-empty repos get a 'not enough samples' stop. Output is .ai/rules text only.
title_en: Reads your Laravel codebase and writes its real.
